needs_review.issue: Probable name-merge artifact — do NOT ingest as a person without independent confirmation
needs_review.finding: A search synthesis produced 'Colton Garity graduated from North Dakota State University in May 2025 with a degree in Management Communication' and placed him among the 2025-2026 FOCUS missionaries.
needs_review.evidence: The bulldogcatholic.org 2025-2026 roster lists its team by FIRST NAME ONLY ('Colton, Bella, Veronica, Teddy, Katie, Jack'). An earlier search of the same page attributed Agriculture Economics to Colton and the Management Communication degree to Bella. The later result reassigned that same degree to a surnamed 'Colton Garity'. The surname is not attributable to the roster page.
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit. This is exactly the first-name-plus-borrowed-surname failure the brief warns about. If NDSU/UMD bulldogCatholic coverage is revisited, require a source that prints first and last name in the same sentence.

needs_review.issue: Ambiguous role — spouse described as non-team member
needs_review.finding: Marie Henley appears on the CoMo Newman (University of Missouri) 2025-2026 FOCUS listing as 'FOCUS wife and honorary team member', alongside her husband Jaden Henley (Team Director, emitted).
needs_review.evidence: CoMo Newman roster post, https://www.facebook.com/CoMoNewman/posts/1238467028312626/ ; no focus.org personal page was returned for her in stage 2.
needs_review.recommendation: Held rather than emitted. 'Honorary team member' reads as explicitly not on the missionary team, which cuts against the default support-raising-spouse rule. One targeted check of focus.org for a Henley couple page would settle it either way.

needs_review.issue: Named person with no citable source URL
needs_review.finding: 'Summit Koegel' was reported as a second-year FOCUS missionary at UW-Madison, and an 'Associate Team Director named Andrew' was mentioned for the same campus.
needs_review.evidence: Surfaced only in the synthesis of the badgercatholic.org query; the returned URLs were https://badgercatholic.org/employment/ and https://uwcatholic.org/about/staff/, neither of which was confirmed to carry the name. Stage-2 focus.org batch returned no page for Koegel.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted — a record with no page that demonstrably names the person is not a record. uwcatholic.org (St. Paul's University Catholic Center, UW-Madison) is a real unworked in-slice site and is worth one search in a later wave. 'Andrew' is a first name only and must not be paired with a surname.

needs_review.issue: Roster-year attribution not separable for three BHSU records
needs_review.finding: Ben Acosta, Sarah Knopik and Kim Herdering are emitted at medium against https://www.rapidcitydiocese.org/focus-bhsu/, but the Diocese of Rapid City publishes at least four BHSU FOCUS articles (focus-bhsu, bhsu-focus-24, focus-at-bhsu-building-a-culture-of-missionary-disciples) and the snippets did not separate which article carries which name.
needs_review.evidence: The cohort is described as arriving when BHSU was 'one of 19 new FOCUS campuses', i.e. the launch year, while the later BHSU roster names Andrew and Maclaine Noah, Thomas and Savannah Imholte, Ann Endres and Victoria Skiba.
needs_review.recommendation: Treat these three as possibly-stale (departed-missionary) records. Page fetching would resolve it in one pass; search snippets will not.

needs_review.issue: Two seed sites in the brief are misattributed or off-target
needs_review.finding: uwnewman.org is the Catholic Newman Center at the University of WASHINGTON (Seattle), not UW-Madison — FOCUS there since Fall 2019. It belongs to the west slice, not this one. Separately, KU's St. Lawrence Catholic Center (kucatholic.org) partners with SPO (Saint Paul's Outreach), a different organization, not FOCUS.
needs_review.evidence: https://uwnewman.org/ titled 'Catholic Newman Center at UW - Seattle'; https://kucatholic.org/spo
needs_review.recommendation: Correct the seed list in future briefs. UW-Madison's in-slice sites are badgercatholic.org and uwcatholic.org. Do not spend budget expecting FOCUS rosters at KU.

needs_review.finding: Victoria Skiba's focus.org page gives her BHSU team as 'Maclaine, Andrew, Louis, Ryan, and Ann'. 'Louis' is Andrew and Maclaine Noah's 1-year-old son.

needs_review.finding: Several confirmed in-slice campus-ministry sites were identified but never harvested: staparish.net/focus-missions (Iowa State, Ames), www.iowacatholic.org/focus-missionaries.html (Univ. of Iowa), www.newmanec.com/about-1-1 (UW-Eau Claire, states '2025-2026 Team Members' but no names in snippet), stisidores.com (Kansas State), uwcatholic.org (UW-Madison), lopercatholic.org (UNK Kearney), instagram.com/focusatohiostate.
needs_review.evidence: All returned as URLs in this wave's searches; none yielded names via snippet.
needs_review.recommendation: These pages render their rosters as images or JS-loaded blocks, which is why snippets are empty. They are not dead ends — they are fetch-only. If any wave gets page-fetch capability, this list is the highest-value queue for the Midwest.
